string-array.name: rd_whats_new_items
string-array.item: A lyrics file with a bad offset no longer closes the app when its song plays.
Folders: a folder of more than 2,000 files is listed and played in full, and Back works after its drive is taken out.
Export playlist writes its file also when the phone is turned while the save dialog is open.
On a TV, Back leaves the app with Home hidden, and Left in a Home row goes one card back.
Check for updates finds the newest app file after many desktop-only releases.
